    Requirements

    Unity version

    Custom Toolbar 2.0.0 requires Unity 2022.3 or newer.

    The package is Editor-only and does not add runtime components to your build.

    Optional integrations

    The core toolbar has no dependency on FMOD or Unity Localization. Their toolbar modules compile only when the matching package is installed.

    Module Optional package Supported version
    FMOD Debug FMOD for Unity (com.firelight.fmod-for-unity) 2.2.0 or newer, below 3.0.0
    Localization Unity Localization (com.unity.localization) 1.0.0 or newer, below 2.0.0

    All other modules are available immediately after installing Custom Toolbar.
